title: Box–Behnken optimized MPA-CdTe quantum dots as turn-off fluorescent probes for sensitive lurasidone determination in pharmaceutical, biological, and environmental matrices
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8855-8866
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00519A, Paper
Open Access

Razaz Abdulaziz Felemban, Maram H. Abduljabbar, Reem M. Alnemari, Rami M. Alzhrani, Yusuf S. Althobaiti, Mohammed F. Aldawsari, Ahmed Serag, Atiah H. Almalki
A sensitive “turn-off” fluorescent method using MPA-CdTe quantum dots was developed for the selective determination of lurasidone in pharmaceutical formulations, spiked plasma, and environmental water samples.
